verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs show narrow export capabilities: journal entries can be exported to accounting tools or a 'generic output file' [adp-run-docs-13], and payroll/HR reports can be viewed, customized and printed online [adp-run-docs-12]. Nothing documents a full-account data export or offboarding path. API Central [adp-run-docs-39] is a developer building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all account data (employees, pay history, tax filings, documents), explicit open formats (CSV/JSON), a documented offboarding/data-portability process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
